units: <cite ref="Eruvin 77a:13">Erub. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>אי אהני מ׳</he> if the reduction has any effect.
<cite ref="Yevamot 119a:9">Yeb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>סמוך מ׳ דמפילות וכ׳</he> add the minority of miscarrying women to the half of female births, and the male births will be a minority.
<cite ref="Chullin 6a:3">Ḥull. 6ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חייש למ׳</he> takes into consideration the minority (the possibility of the rarer cases).
<cite ref="Yevamot 119b:2">Yeb. 119ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ דמ׳ לא חייש</he> a minority of a minority he does not take into consideration.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 80a:7">Kidd. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ כמאן דליתא דמי</he> a minority is considered as non-existent.—Pl. <he>מִיעוּטֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 45b:24">Snh. 45ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>דריש ריבויי ומ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01259">preced.</cite>
